description: This is a bash shell script for managing a Kubernetes-in-Docker (Kind) cluster. It includes functions for creating or deleting a cluster, detecting the container engine, and setting up Kubernetes contexts with various command-line options.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs an informational message formatted in blue.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Outputs a success message formatted in green.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message formatted in yellow.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message formatted in red and exits.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: provider_installed
methods.description: Checks if a command-line provider (docker or podman) is installed.

methods.name: provider_responsive
methods.description: Checks if a container provider (docker or podman) is responsive.

methods.name: detect_provider
methods.description: Detects whether 'docker' or 'podman' is installed and responsive.
